title: Forward scan configuration
statement: Given a symbol alphabet, a number $k$ of work tapes, a selected tape $i<k$, a word $w$, a configuration $d$ for input $x$ and the writing phases associated to $w$, and a natural number $r$, define the resulting configuration by running the word-writing scan from $d$ in phase $\mathrm{wr}(\min(r,|w|))$, with the input-head position taken from $d$ and scan parameter $r$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A configuration $d$ for input $x$ and the phases associated to $w$
caveat: The definition delegates its behavior to a word-scanning operation whose definition is not included in the payload.
